primary_goal: Drive visitors to search for classified ads, browse listing categories, or log in / register to post and save items.

friction_points.issue: Intrusive registration popup automatically overlays search controls and listing content on initial page view.
friction_points.evidence: In screenshot 1, a white modal banner ('Hallo! Willkommen bei Kleinanzeigen...') floats directly over the top header navigation and top gallery listings.

friction_points.issue: Frequent fallback images displaying generic logo graphics obscure item context across the feed.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 1, 2, and 3 show multiple feed cards (such as 'Ich reperiere dein roller', 'Zwischenmiete Frauen-WG', 'Fundstück Brosche') using only a green heart logo placeholder.

friction_points.issue: Lack of consistent buyer protection and trust signals on individual listing cards.
friction_points.evidence: Only one listing in screenshot 3 ('Rupes LHR75E mini Bigfoot') features a green 'Direkt kaufen' badge; all other cards display no payment or safety guarantees.

friction_points.issue: Commercial advertisements visually blend with organic classified listings, causing confusion.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshot 2 includes full-card commercial advertisements ('Barsbo Service', 'Ford Fiesta') formatted with identical card dimensions to peer-to-peer listings.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we trigger the welcome registration modal only upon explicit user intent (e.g. clicking favorite or sending a message) instead of automatic page load, then engagement depth will increase because visitors can interact with search without immediate pop-up friction.
hypotheses.change: Remove automatic page-load registration popup and defer modal display to high-intent actions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display category-specific default icons for listings missing images, then listing click-through rate will improve because visitors immediately understand the listing category.
hypotheses.change: Replace generic brand logo fallbacks with contextual category placeholders (e.g., housing, mobility, services icons).

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we prominently display 'Sicher bezahlen' badges on eligible feed cards, then lead generation and direct purchases will increase because German buyers prioritize payment safety.
hypotheses.change: Add clear visual trust badges for payment protection on all eligible feed cards.

quick_wins: Ensure top welcome modal does not obscure search bar fields on standard desktop resolutions.
Clearly label commercial business cards in the grid with a distinct background shade or explicit 'Anzeige' label to distinguish them from user listings.
uncertainties: Whether the welcome popup is shown to all unauthenticated users or tied to cookie/session logic.
The algorithmic logic determining personalized listings in the 'Neueste Anzeigen' section for non-logged-in users.
